voice_frame_policy: Every active voice on each staff uses the three-quarter-note bar frame. No voice numbering or musical rest content is prescribed.

addressing.physical_bars: P001..P095, continuous in printed order, without repeat expansion.
addressing.staff_ids: 1=upper and 2=lower, globally stable; both belong to one piano player, canonical part P1.
addressing.onset: Rational quarter-note offsets from the physical region start. Grace timing does not enlarge a region.
addressing.coordinates: Frozen full-page pixel coordinates; boxes use left, top, right, bottom with exclusive right/bottom.
addressing.barline_policy: One shared boundary per printed barline across both staves; double/repeat strokes form one boundary. Opening signatures remain visible in first-bar crops.
addressing.fingering_scope: Preserve printed fingering glyphs at note or chord-member addresses; distinguish them from triplet numerals. Full pages retain all header/footer and notation evidence.
